en.commentary:
Sony dropped the PS5 back to $549.99 on August 21. Nintendo takes the Switch 2 to $499.99 on September 1. Eleven days apart, moving in opposite directions, and that single pair of facts decides this ranking.

The PS5 Slim takes first place because it is the one console here that costs less today than it did in July. Sony reversed the entire April hike: the disc model went from $649.99 back to $549.99, the Digital Edition from $599.99 to $499.99, and the Pro from $899.99 to $749.99. US PS5 unit sales fell 58% year over year in May, the worst May in 26 years, and Sony read that number correctly. A price cut delivered in the middle of a memory shortage tells you what Sony expects demand to look like through the holidays, and it hands buyers the best hardware value on this page.

The Switch 2 at $449.99 is the sharpest deal on this page for four more days. On September 1 it becomes $499.99 in the US and NT$15,880 in Taiwan, up from NT$14,380. My advice is to buy now and treat $499.99 as the floor for the rest of this console's life. Micron's new capacity arrives in Q3 2028, and Counterpoint expects DRAM supply to stay tight through the end of 2027.

Then there is the Xbox arithmetic, which genuinely surprised me. A $799.99 Series X plus 36 months of Game Pass Ultimate at $22.99 comes to $1,627.63. A $549.99 PS5 plus PS Plus Extra at $16.99 comes to $1,161.63 before a single game. Seven full-price games at $69.99 closes that $466 gap. Buy three new releases a year and the most expensive console on this page is your cheapest three-year path.

highlights.title: Buy the Switch 2 this week, because $499.99 is the floor for the rest of its life
highlights.body: Nintendo confirmed the US MSRP moves from $449.99 to $499.99 on September 1, and Taiwan moves from NT$14,380 to NT$15,880 the same day. President Shuntaro Furukawa attributed it to permanent increases in memory component costs, exchange rates and oil prices, and the demo kiosks in retail have been advertising the change since mid-August. I say buy now, and the reason is supply timing. Micron's new fab capacity comes online in Q3 2028, and Counterpoint expects DRAM to stay tight through the end of 2027. Anyone holding out for a cheaper Switch 2 is waiting on a market that gets tighter first. Treat this week's $449.99 as the last time this console is available at its launch price.

highlights.title: Sony's August 21 rollback makes the PS5 the only console that got cheaper in 2026
highlights.body: Every other manufacturer on this page moved in one direction this year. Sony went the other way, and it did it on the exact anniversary of its first-ever PS5 price increase. All three SKUs returned to their pre-April numbers: $549.99 disc, $499.99 Digital, $749.99 Pro. The trigger was demand destruction. May US PS5 unit sales were down 58% year over year and revenue was down 43%, the worst May in 26 years. This reads as a durable buy signal because Sony absorbed the cut while memory contract prices were still climbing 80% to 95% quarter over quarter. That is a company choosing installed base over margin going into the holidays, and buyers get the benefit right now.

highlights.title: At three new games a year, the $799.99 Xbox Series X is the cheapest three-year plan here
highlights.body: Run the numbers before you judge the sticker. Series X at $799.99 plus Game Pass Ultimate at $22.99 for 36 months totals $1,627.63, and that figure includes the games. PS5 at $549.99 plus PS Plus Extra at $16.99 for 36 months totals $1,161.63, and that figure includes zero purchased games. The gap is $466, which is 6.7 full-price games at $69.99. So the break-even sits at roughly 2.2 new releases a year. Below that, the PS5 wins on total cost and I would take it. Above it, the console with the highest sticker price on this page delivers the lowest three-year bill, and it is worth saying plainly because no other ranking I have read puts that number in front of readers.

highlights.title: The 512GB Series S at $499.99 is the Xbox I would actually recommend at this price level
highlights.body: Microsoft's August 1 increase pushed the 1TB Series S to $599.99, up 71% from its $349.99 launch price, which puts it $200 below a full Series X while sitting a performance tier down. The 512GB model at $499.99 is where this machine still makes complete sense: it plays every Game Pass title at 1440p, it is the smallest console Microsoft builds, and Game Pass Ultimate means the smaller SSD matters less because you cycle titles in and out. For a second TV, a dorm room or a kid's setup, this is the right Xbox, and if you want the bigger drive, that extra $200 goes further toward a Series X.

highlights.title: The Steam Machine at $1,049 is the most honest price tag in this entire market
highlights.body: Valve sells hardware at cost and says so, which makes the $1,049 entry configuration a published receipt for what mid-2026 silicon actually costs. Set that against Microsoft losing roughly $150 on every $799.99 Series X and you can see the real shape of console economics right now: the subsidised boxes have been repriced toward their true cost, and the gap between a loss-leader console and an at-cost PC has closed to about $250. The Steam Machine also runs roughly six times the graphics performance of a Steam Deck and opens the entire Steam library with its sale pricing, which changes the software cost side of the equation as much as the hardware side.

zh-tw.commentary:
先講結論，這四天是台灣玩家用原價買 Switch 2 的最後機會。9 月 1 日起台灣建議售價從 NT$14,380 調整為 NT$15,880，一次多 1,500 元，差不多就是一片大作的錢。

老實說，2026 年的主機價格走向整個反過來了。Sony 在 8 月 21 日把美國 PS5 全線降回去，光碟版從 649.99 美元回到 549.99 美元，數位版回到 499.99 美元，Pro 從 899.99 回到 749.99。原因很直接，5 月美國 PS5 銷量年減 58%，是 26 年來最慘的五月，Sony 看懂了這個數字，而且是在記憶體合約價還在季增 80% 到 95% 的時候做這個決定，等於選了裝機量放掉毛利。

台灣這邊還沒跟進。SIE 台灣 5 月 1 日才調漲，光碟版 NT$19,989、數位版 NT$17,989、Pro NT$27,478，到今天都還是這個價。所以我的建議是，本來就想買 PS5 的人先觀望，看 SIE 台灣會不會在耶誕檔期前跟上美國的調降，這個等待成本很低。

Xbox 這邊我實際算了一下，結果跟直覺相反。Series X 光碟版 799.99 美元，加上 36 個月 Game Pass Ultimate 每月 22.99 美元，三年是 1,627.63 美元，而且遊戲全含在裡面。PS5 549.99 加 PS Plus 進階版每月 16.99 美元，三年 1,161.63 美元，這個數字裡面一片遊戲都還沒買。差距 466 美元，換算 69.99 美元一片，等於七片。三年買超過七片新遊戲的人，標價最貴的那台才是總花費最低的那一條路。

最後補一個台灣專屬的算法，公司貨跟水貨的價差。漲價前後水貨的價差會被放大，日版機的帳號區域跟中文化支援是實際會踩到的坑，保固更是只有公司貨進得了台灣任天堂的維修體系。這 1,500 元的漲幅，跟一次送修的來回運費加上等待時間比起來，其實划算得多。

highlights.title: Switch 2 這週就要下手，NT$15,880 會是接下來的地板價
highlights.body: 任天堂已經公告美國建議售價 9 月 1 日從 449.99 美元調整為 499.99 美元，台灣同日從 NT$14,380 調整為 NT$15,880，社長古川俊太郎把原因講得很白，記憶體零件成本、匯率跟油價的上升是長期性的。八月中開始各大通路的試玩機台就已經在跑漲價告知了。我建議這週就下手，理由是供給時程。美光的新產能要到 2028 年第三季才開出，Counterpoint 推估 DRAM 供給緊到 2027 年底都不會實質緩解。想等 Switch 2 變便宜的人，等到的會是更緊的市場。這個禮拜的 NT$14,380 就是這台主機最後一次用上市價買到。

highlights.title: Sony 8 月 21 日的調降，讓 PS5 成為 2026 年唯一變便宜的主機
highlights.body: 這一頁上其他廠商今年全部往上走，Sony 往下走，而且挑在自己第一次 PS5 漲價的整整一年後動手。三個型號全部回到四月漲價前的數字，光碟版 549.99 美元、數位版 499.99 美元、Pro 749.99 美元。觸發點是需求崩掉，5 月美國 PS5 銷量年減 58%、金額年減 43%，26 年來最差的五月。說真的，這個動作值得注意的地方在於時機，Sony 是在記憶體合約價還在季增 80% 到 95% 的時候吃下這個成本，代表它把耶誕檔期的裝機量看得比毛利重要。台灣讀者要注意的是，這波調降目前只發生在美國，台灣還停在 5 月的 NT$19,989，想買的人可以再等一下看看。

highlights.title: 一年買三片新遊戲，799.99 美元的 Series X 就是三年最省的那條路
highlights.body: 這題要算過才有答案，光看標價會判斷錯。Series X 799.99 美元加 Game Pass Ultimate 每月 22.99 美元乘 36 個月，總共 1,627.63 美元，遊戲全含。PS5 549.99 美元加 PS Plus 進階版每月 16.99 美元乘 36 個月，總共 1,161.63 美元，這裡面一片遊戲都沒買。差 466 美元，用 69.99 美元一片去除，等於 6.7 片，換算下來損益兩平點大約在一年 2.2 片新作。低於這個量，PS5 的總成本比較低，我也會直接推 PS5。高於這個量，標價最高的那台反而是三年帳單最低的選擇。這個數字我沒在任何一份中文榜單上看過，但它才是這個決策真正的關鍵。

highlights.title: 512GB 版 Series S 賣 499.99 美元，這才是這個價位帶我會推的 Xbox
highlights.body: 微軟 8 月 1 日調漲之後，1TB 版 Series S 來到 599.99 美元，比上市時的 349.99 美元漲了 71%，跟完整版 Series X 只差 200 美元。512GB 版 499.99 美元，換算約 NT$15,500，這個配置的定位還是很清楚，Game Pass 上所有遊戲都能跑 1440p，機身是微軟做過最小的一台，而且訂閱制的玩法本來就是玩完換下一片，SSD 容量的影響會比想像中小。放在客廳第二台電視、租屋處或小孩房，這台就是正確答案。想要 1TB 的人，那 200 美元的差額直接往 Series X 加上去更划算。

highlights.title: Steam Machine 賣 1,049 美元，是整個市場現在最誠實的一個價格
highlights.body: Valve 直說硬體是成本價出貨，所以 1,049 美元這個入門配置等於把 2026 年中的真實零件成本公開給所有人看。把它跟微軟每賣一台 799.99 美元 Series X 就虧約 150 美元放在一起看，現在主機經濟學的樣貌就很清楚了，補貼型主機的售價已經被重新校正到接近真實成本，而虧本主機跟成本價 PC 之間的差距縮到大約 250 美元。Steam Machine 的效能大約是 Steam Deck 的六倍，而且直接開整個 Steam 遊戲庫，Steam 的特價幅度在軟體端省下來的錢，影響不會比硬體端小。台灣目前沒有官方代理，得走代購，換算約 NT$32,500 起。

references.title: Price Revision for Nintendo Switch 2 System

en.commentary: This is the last weekend to buy a Nintendo Switch 2 at $449.99. The standalone price rises to $499.99 on September 1, matching what the Mario Kart World bundle costs today. If you have been waiting, buy the bundle before Monday, because you get a full game for the price the console alone will cost in three days. That is the clearest actionable advice I have given in this category all year. I have lowered the Switch 2 price scores to reflect the increase, and its overall score moves to 9.1 while it keeps second place. The exclusive lineup and three-year total cost are still strong enough to hold that position comfortably. The PlayStation 5 Slim stays first at 9.4 and its case got stronger this month. Sony brought the price back down to $549.99 on August 21 after raising it in April, which makes the pricing outlook here the most stable of any console on this list. Buying a PS5 today means you are unlikely to watch the price fall next month. The Xbox Series X at 8.6 remains the performance leader, and Game Pass subscription value is still the best argument for it. The Valve Steam Machine at 8.0 starts at $1,049, which places it in a different conversation entirely.

highlights.title: Buy the Switch 2 before September 1
highlights.body: The standalone console goes from $449.99 to $499.99 on Monday. The Mario Kart World bundle currently sells for $499.99, which means buying the bundle this weekend gets you a full game for what the bare console will cost next week. This is a real deadline, not a marketing one.

highlights.title: PS5 pricing stability is now its strongest feature
highlights.body: Sony raised the price in April and brought it back to $549.99 on August 21. Two moves in one year normally worries me, but landing back down means buyers today are not watching a discount arrive a month later. That certainty holds first place at 9.4.

highlights.title: The Switch 2 keeps second on its library, not its price
highlights.body: A fifty dollar increase changes the value calculation, and I have scored it accordingly. What holds the position is the exclusive lineup, which no other platform matches, and a three-year total cost that stays low because Nintendo games hold value and the subscription is inexpensive.

zh-tw.commentary:
這是用 449.99 美元買到 Nintendo Switch 2 的最後一個週末。單機價格 9 月 1 號調到 499.99 美元，跟現在《瑪利歐賽車世界》同捆組的價格一樣。

所以如果你一直在等，週一之前去買同捆組，因為你用三天後單機的價格拿到一款完整遊戲。這大概是我今年在這個品類給過最明確、最能馬上執行的建議了。

我把 Switch 2 的價格相關分數往下調，總分變成 9.1，位置維持第二。獨佔陣容跟三年總持有成本還是夠強，第二名守得很輕鬆。

PlayStation 5 Slim 以 9.4 分續坐第一，而且這個月它的說服力更強了。Sony 四月漲價之後，8 月 21 號又把價格調回 549.99 美元，這讓它成為這份清單上價格走勢最穩定的主機。今天買 PS5，你不太需要擔心下個月看到它降價。

Xbox Series X 8.6 分依然是效能王，Game Pass 的訂閱價值也還是它最強的論述。

Valve Steam Machine 8.0 分，起價 1,049 美元，講白了它已經是另一個層級的討論了。

highlights.title: Switch 2 要買就在 9 月 1 號之前
highlights.body: 單機從 449.99 美元漲到 499.99 美元，週一生效。《瑪利歐賽車世界》同捆組現在賣 499.99 美元，也就是這個週末買同捆組，等於用下週單機的錢多拿一款完整遊戲。這是真的死線，不是行銷話術。

highlights.title: PS5 現在最強的優勢是價格穩定
highlights.body: Sony 四月調漲，8 月 21 號又調回 549.99 美元。一年動兩次通常會讓我皺眉，但既然是往下落回來，今天買的人就不用擔心一個月後折扣才出現。這份確定性撐住了 9.4 分的第一名。

highlights.title: Switch 2 守住第二靠的是遊戲陣容
highlights.body: 漲五十美元確實改變了性價比的算法，我也照實調整了分數。真正守住位置的是沒有別的平台追得上的獨佔陣容，加上任天堂遊戲保值、訂閱費又便宜所帶來的低三年總成本。

references.title: Steam Frame Release Date & Price: Still TBD

en.commentary:
The PlayStation 5 Slim with a disc drive holds first at 9.4, and the disc drive is a bigger part of that verdict than people expect. Physical games can be bought used, sold on, lent to a friend and played when a server eventually goes dark. Over a five year ownership period, that is worth real money, and the price gap between the disc and digital models is recovered within a handful of second-hand purchases. Sony's exclusive library remains the strongest reason to own the machine.

The Nintendo Switch 2 at 9.1 is the console I would recommend to a household rather than a person. It plays in a living room and on a train, its library is the best in the industry for playing with other people in the same room, and Nintendo's own software is consistently excellent in a way no other publisher matches. Different job, and it does that job better than anything else.

The Xbox Series X at 8.6 is a superb piece of hardware with a strategy problem. Game Pass remains the best value in gaming and the exclusivity picture keeps softening, which weakens the case for the box specifically even as it strengthens the case for the service.

Valve's Steam Machine sits at 8.0 and I expect that number to move. Valve is clearly in a hardware phase right now, with Steam Frame close to launch, and the living room strategy is worth watching this autumn.

highlights.title: The disc drive is worth more than the price difference
highlights.body: Physical games can be bought used, resold, lent out, and played after servers close. Across five years of ownership those savings exceed the premium over the digital model within a handful of second-hand purchases. That is why the disc version of the PS5 Slim holds first at 9.4.

highlights.title: The Switch 2 is the household console, and that is a real category
highlights.body: It works in the living room and on a train, and its library is the best in the industry for playing with people who are physically in the same room. At 9.1 it is doing a different job from the PlayStation, and it does that job better than anything else available.

highlights.title: The Xbox Series X has great hardware and a strategy problem
highlights.body: Game Pass remains the best value proposition in gaming and the exclusivity picture keeps softening. That combination strengthens the service and weakens the argument for the specific box. At 8.6 the hardware deserves better positioning than the strategy currently gives it.

highlights.title: Watch Valve's living room play this autumn
highlights.body: Steam Machine sits at 8.0 today and Valve is visibly in a hardware phase, with Steam Frame approaching launch. If the living room strategy comes together, that number moves. It is the most interesting variable in this category heading into the end of the year.

zh-tw.commentary:
PS5 Slim 光碟版守住第一 9.4 分，而光碟機在這個判斷裡的比重比多數人以為的高。

實體片可以買二手、可以賣掉、可以借朋友，伺服器有天關掉之後還能玩。以五年的持有期來看，這是實實在在的錢，而光碟版跟數位版的價差，大概買賣幾片二手就補回來了。Sony 的獨佔陣容仍然是擁有這台機器最強的理由。

Nintendo Switch 2 9.1 分，是我會推薦給「一個家庭」而不是「一個人」的主機。客廳能玩、捷運上也能玩，而且它的遊戲庫在「跟同一個房間裡的人一起玩」這件事上是業界最強的，任天堂自家軟體的水準穩定到沒有其他發行商追得上。不同的工作，而它把這個工作做得比誰都好。

Xbox Series X 8.6 分，是很棒的硬體配上一個策略問題。Game Pass 還是遊戲界最超值的服務，但獨佔的界線一直在鬆動，這強化了服務、卻削弱了「一定要買這個盒子」的理由。

Valve 的 Steam Machine 8.0 分，我預期這個數字會動。Valve 現在明顯進入硬體週期，Steam Frame 也快上市了，客廳戰略這條線這個秋天值得盯著。

highlights.title: 光碟機的價值高於那個價差
highlights.body: 實體片能買二手、能轉賣、能借人、伺服器關了還能玩。以五年持有期來算，這些省下來的錢大概買賣幾片二手就超過光碟版的溢價了。這就是 PS5 Slim 光碟版守住 9.4 跟第一名的原因。

highlights.title: Switch 2 是家庭主機，而這是一個真實存在的類別
highlights.body: 客廳能玩、捷運上也能玩，遊戲庫在「跟同一個房間裡的人一起玩」這件事上是業界最強。9.1 分，它做的是跟 PlayStation 不同的工作，而這個工作它做得比市面上任何東西都好。

highlights.title: Xbox Series X 是好硬體配上策略問題
highlights.body: Game Pass 還是遊戲界最超值的方案，而獨佔的界線持續鬆動。這個組合強化了服務，卻削弱了「非買這個盒子不可」的論述。8.6 分，這個硬體值得比目前策略給它的更好的定位。

highlights.title: 這個秋天盯著 Valve 的客廳布局
highlights.body: Steam Machine 現在 8.0 分，而 Valve 明顯進入硬體週期，Steam Frame 也逼近上市。如果客廳戰略拼起來了，這個數字會動。這是這個類別走向年底最值得觀察的變數。

references.title: Steam Frame Release Date & Price: Still TBD

en.commentary: The PlayStation 5 Slim with disc drive holds first and the disc drive is doing more work in that ranking than people expect. A physical library is resellable, lendable, and immune to a storefront delisting a title you paid for. In a period where console pricing has moved upward across the industry, the ability to buy used and sell on is a real economic advantage rather than a nostalgia preference. Add the strongest exclusive lineup and the ranking holds itself up. The Switch 2 at second has the best portable to television flexibility ever built into a console, and its first year library has arrived faster than the original Switch's did. The Xbox Series X at third gives you the best subscription value in gaming, and if your household plays broadly rather than deeply, that library access changes the maths entirely. The PS5 Digital at fourth and the Xbox Series X Digital at fifth trade that physical flexibility for a lower entry price. Nothing shifted this week. My advice for buyers this autumn: check three year total cost including the subscription you will realistically keep, since the console price is the smaller number.

highlights.title: A disc drive is an economic feature, not nostalgia
highlights.body: Physical games are resellable, lendable, and immune to storefront delisting. With console pricing moving upward across the industry, the ability to buy used and sell on is a genuine advantage worth paying for up front.

highlights.title: Calculate three year cost including subscriptions
highlights.body: The console price is the smaller number over a typical ownership period. Add the service you will realistically keep for three years and the ranking between digital and disc models often reverses.

highlights.title: Xbox wins on breadth of access
highlights.body: If your household plays many games shallowly rather than a few deeply, subscription library access changes the value calculation entirely. That is the specific scenario where the Series X is the right purchase.

zh-tw.commentary:
PlayStation 5 Slim 光碟版排第一，而那個光碟機在這個排名裡承擔的份量比大家以為的重。

實體片可以轉賣、可以借人，而且不會因為數位商店下架就讓你付過的錢消失。在整個產業主機價格都往上走的時期，能買二手也能賣掉，是實打實的經濟優勢，不是懷舊情懷。台灣二手遊戲片的流通一直很活絡，這個價值特別具體。再加上最強的獨佔陣容，這個排名站得住。

Switch 2 第二名，掌機跟電視之間的切換彈性是主機史上最好的，首年遊戲陣容的到位速度也比初代 Switch 快。

Xbox Series X 第三名，訂閱制的價值是遊戲界最好的。如果你家是廣泛地玩很多款而不是深入玩幾款，遊戲庫的取用權會整個改變這筆帳。

PS5 數位版第四、Xbox Series X 數位版第五，用實體彈性換比較低的入手價。

這週沒有變動。給今年秋天要買的人：算三年總花費，把你實際上會續訂的服務加進去，因為主機價格是那兩個數字裡比較小的一個。

highlights.title: 光碟機是經濟功能，不是懷舊
highlights.body: 實體片能轉賣、能借人，也不會因為商店下架就消失。在主機價格全面往上走的時期，買得到二手也賣得掉，是值得先付錢買下的真實優勢。

highlights.title: 算三年總成本，要含訂閱
highlights.body: 以一般的持有期間來看，主機價格是比較小的那個數字。把你三年內實際會續訂的服務加上去，數位版跟光碟版的排序常常會反過來。

highlights.title: Xbox 贏在遊戲取用的廣度
highlights.body: 如果你家是很多款都玩一點而不是深耕幾款，訂閱制的遊戲庫會整個改變價值計算。這正是 Series X 成為正確選擇的那個情境。
